# About the study

<p class="lede">`r site$paper$title`. `r site$paper$authors_short`. `r site$paper$status`.</p>

## How it was done

We measured the cortex in two ways, thickness and surface area, and compared standardized
group differences (Cohen's d, adjusted for age, sex and scanning site) across three kinds of
data that were analysed separately. For 11 copy number variants and sex chromosome
aneuploidies we had individual brain MRI scans of carriers and controls; for 7 more variants
we used published estimates. For psychiatric diagnoses we used published case-control
results from the ENIGMA consortium: 9 main case-control groups, with medication subgroups
and age-stratified groups as further analyses. For common variants we looked up disorder-linked
variants in a large genetic study of cortical structure and tested polygenic risk scores in
UK Biobank.

Regional maps (34 regions, averaged across hemispheres) were summarised into one shared
pattern per data type and compared with the sensorimotor-to-association gradient using spin
tests. The full methods, statistics and sensitivity analyses are in the paper.

## Data sources

```{r sources, results='asis'}
var_pmids <- unique(global$pmid[global$group == "variant"])
dx_pmids  <- unique(global$pmid[global$group == "diagnosis"])
cat('<table class="sources-table"><thead><tr><th>Data</th><th>Sample</th><th>Source</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
cat('<tr><td>Rare variants, individual-level MRI</td><td>', site$samples$variants_mri, '</td><td>This study; cohorts listed in the paper</td></tr>')
cat('<tr><td>Rare variants, published estimates</td><td>', site$samples$variants_published, '</td><td>', paste(vapply(var_pmids, pmid_link, ""), collapse = ", "), '</td></tr>')
cat('<tr><td>Psychiatric diagnoses</td><td>', site$samples$diagnoses_groups, '; medication subgroups; age-stratified groups as sensitivity analyses</td><td>ENIGMA: ', paste(vapply(dx_pmids, pmid_link, ""), collapse = ", "), '</td></tr>')
cat('<tr><td>Common variants, cortical lookup</td><td>', site$samples$cortical_gwas, '</td><td>Psychiatric Genomics Consortium and ENIGMA genome-wide studies</td></tr>')
cat('<tr><td>Polygenic risk scores</td><td>', site$samples$prs, '</td><td>UK Biobank</td></tr>')
cat('</tbody></table>')
```

The site shows only results reported in the paper and its supplementary tables. It does not
host individual-level data or genome-wide summary statistics.

## Limitations

- The results are group-level associations from cross-sectional data; they do not show cause and effect, and they do not apply to any one person.
- Common-variant analyses used European-ancestry genetic studies and UK Biobank participants of European ancestry; the results may differ in other ancestries.
- Medication status may also reflect illness severity or duration, which could not be separated here.
- The analysis of opposing effects covers bipolar disorder and schizophrenia only; evidence from the variance test is stronger for schizophrenia.
- The set of rare variants depended on which carriers had MRI scans available.

## How to cite

```{r cite, results='asis'}
doi_txt <- if (nzchar(site$paper$doi)) sprintf(' <a href="https://doi.org/%s">doi:%s</a>', site$paper$doi, site$paper$doi) else if (nzchar(site$paper$preprint_url)) sprintf(' Preprint: <a href="%s">%s</a>', site$paper$preprint_url, site$paper$preprint_url) else ""
cat(sprintf('<p class="cite">%s. %s. <em>%s</em>.%s</p>',
            site$paper$authors_short, site$paper$title, site$paper$journal, doi_txt))
```

Analysis code for the paper's figures: [GitHub](`r site$paper$code_url`).
